comment.body:
Thanks for the version, Windows build and helper-restart timing. That dialog can follow several local helper-to-engine failures, so it does not by itself identify a network or signing problem.

1. Please report whether mouse/keyboard control between the PCs still works while clipboard sharing fails, and the exact last-working PowerToys version.
2. Immediately after the helper error on each PC, add `/bugreport` and follow the diagnostic-ZIP collection instructions; mark which capture belongs to each PC and the approximate error time. Include the matching Windows Event Viewer > Windows Logs > Application event from MouseWithoutBordersHelper if the ZIP does not contain it. The underlying message distinguishes connection timeout, identity rejection and later clipboard/RPC failure.

Please keep the current security checks enabled; do not change certificates or firewall settings solely from this generic dialog.
